title: Left or right
starting_code:
# One door is locked, the other is open.
# Choose the open door to reach the way down.
hints: Use `if` to check if the left door is locked.
If it is, go to the right door and open it.
Use `else` to go to the left door and open it when it is not locked, then move down to the exit.
intro: There are two doors here, {wizard}, but one of them is locked. We need to check one door, and choose the other if it will not open.
outro: Brilliant. Knowing what to do when the answer is no is just as important as knowing what to do when it is yes.
learned: Now you know how `else` chooses what to do when the answer is no.
